description: Two-Spark TensorFold configuration from taussoe/tensorfold-recipes at d8a7c09c, using the creator's glm-long-context engine fork at c32abe92. Both ranks mount the same immutable checkpoint; the Controller supplies rank and rendezvous information. The default uses one stream and an explicit 131,072-token window. Memory is a conservative estimate carried from the single-Spark configuration per node, not a measurement. CUDA kernels compile into the managed cache on first start. Text-only serving; physical two-Spark performance and recovery remain unmeasured here.
title: Qwen3.8 Flash Next TensorFold dual Spark (taussoe)
